email.layout.footer: You get this email because of activity on your {{appName}} account.
email.layout.linkFallback: If the button does not work, open this link:
email.passwordReset.subject: Reset your password
email.passwordReset.heading: Reset your password
email.passwordReset.body: We received a request to reset the password for your account. The link expires in {{minutes}} minutes.
email.passwordReset.ignore: If you did not ask for a password reset, ignore this email. Your password stays the same.
email.emailVerification.subject: Verify your email address
email.emailVerification.heading: Verify your email address
email.emailVerification.body: Confirm that this email address belongs to you. The link expires in {{hours}} hours.
email.emailVerification.ignore: If you did not create an account, ignore this email.
email.invitation.subject: You have been invited to {{organizationName}}
email.invitation.heading: Join {{organizationName}}
email.invitation.body: {{inviterName}} invited you to join {{organizationName}} as {{role}}. Sign in with this email address to accept or decline the invitation.
email.twoFactorCode.subject: Your sign-in verification code
email.twoFactorCode.heading: Your verification code
email.twoFactorCode.body: Enter this code to finish signing in.
email.twoFactorCode.ignore: If you did not try to sign in, change your password.
email.emailOtp.heading: Your one-time code
email.emailOtp.body: Enter this code to continue. It expires in {{minutes}} minutes.
email.emailOtp.ignore: If you did not ask for this code, ignore this email.
email.welcome.subject: Welcome to {{appName}}
email.welcome.heading: Welcome to {{appName}}
email.welcome.body: Your account is ready. Your personal organization is set up, so you can start right away.
email.securityAlert.notYou: If you did not make this change, reset your password right away.
email.passwordChanged.subject: Your password was changed
email.passwordChanged.heading: Your password was changed
email.passwordChanged.body: The password for your account was changed.
email.emailChanged.subject: Your email address was changed
email.emailChanged.heading: Your email address was changed
email.emailChanged.body: The email address for your account was changed to {{newEmail}}. This notice goes to your previous address.
email.twoFactorEnabled.subject: Two-factor authentication is on
email.twoFactorEnabled.heading: Two-factor authentication is on
email.twoFactorEnabled.body: Two-factor authentication was turned on for your account. Each password sign-in now needs a second step.
